# AllOEMManuals Full Technical & LLM Documentation

> AllOEMManuals (alloemmanuals.com) — Complete index of AI endpoints, repair schemas, and vehicle manual coverage for LLM agents.

## Overview

AllOEMManuals provides step-by-step DIY auto repair guides, DTC diagnostic trouble code lookups, wiring diagrams, and part recommendations for 300,000+ vehicle variants (1960–2025).

## Machine API Endpoints (x402 & OpenAPI)

- [AI Training Feed Endpoint](https://alloemmanuals.com/api/data/2020/toyota/camry): x402 paywalled clean Markdown ($0.01 per page).
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://alloemmanuals.com/openapi.json): Full API schema for vehicle repair procedures, wiring diagrams, and trouble codes.
- [Agentic Commerce Protocol](https://alloemmanuals.com/.well-known/acp.json): Payment and discovery specification.
- [MCP Server Card](https://alloemmanuals.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol metadata.
